Flat Press (DB): Independent dumbbell paths on a flat bench.
Chest Press (Machine): Flat-style machine press with a supported torso.
Smith Machine Bench Press: Flat press with a guided bar path.
Paused Bench Press (BB): Same flat barbell press with a controlled pause on the chest.
Reverse-Grip Bench Press (BB): Existing option: reverse grip changes wrist position and pressing emphasis.
Seal Row (DB): Prone bench support with independently moving dumbbells.
Seal Row (BB): Prone bench support with a barbell.
Seated Cable Row: Seated cable resistance; torso bracing differs from chest support.
Hack Squat: Supported squat path; knee and hip angles differ from a leg press.
Pendulum Squat: Supported squat with an arcing machine path.
Lying Leg Curl: Prone position changes the hip angle versus a seated curl.
Lateral Raise (DB): Same side raise using dumbbells rather than cable or machine resistance.
Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise: One side at a time; log reps per arm.
Lean-Away Cable Lateral Raise: Side raise with a supported lean and a different cable angle.
Neutral-Grip Pulldown: Palms-facing handle; same overhead pulling pattern.
Wide-Grip Pulldown: Wider overhand handle changes elbow path and available range.
Assisted Pull-Up: Machine assistance changes effective load; retain the app’s effective-bodyweight logging.
Trap-Bar Carry: Bilateral carry inside a trap bar; log TOTAL loaded bar weight.
Incline Press (BB): Same incline pressing angle with a shared barbell path.
Smith Machine Incline Press: Incline press with a guided bar path.
Rear-Delt Cable Fly: Reverse fly using cables rather than dumbbells or a pec-deck machine.
EZ-Bar Curl: Angled bar changes wrist position; keep the upper arms at the sides.
Alternating Curl (DB): Alternate palms-up curls; log reps per arm.
Rope Pressdown: Rope attachment allows the hands to separate at extension.
Single-Arm Pressdown: One arm at a time; log reps per arm.
Cable Triceps Extension: Existing option: use the arm-at-side setup to stay close to this pressdown slot.
Belt Squat: Load hangs at the hips; squat mechanics differ from the leg-press sled.
Seated Calf Raise: Existing option: bent knees shift emphasis toward the soleus; not identical to straight-knee raises.
Smith Machine Calf Raise: Standing straight-knee calf raise under a guided bar.
Standing Calf Raise (DB): Standing calf raise with dumbbell resistance.
Donkey Calf Raise: Hips hinged with knees mostly straight; load placement differs.
Hanging Leg Raise: Longer leg lever than the bent-knee raise; control the pelvic curl.
Towel Hang: Towel grip changes hand position and grip demand.
Chest-Supported T-Bar Row: Chest support with a fixed handle path.
Horizontal Leg Press: Seated, horizontal sled path rather than an angled sled.
Standing Leg Curl (Machine): Standing support; train one leg at a time. Log reps per leg.
Seated Leg Curl (Single-Leg): Same seated knee-flexion pattern, one leg at a time. Log reps per leg.
Lying Leg Curl (Single-Leg): Same lying knee-flexion pattern, one leg at a time. Log reps per leg.
Seated Lateral Raise (DB): Seated position limits torso movement during the side raise.
Neutral-Grip Pull-Up: Palms face one another; keep the same controlled vertical pull.
Farmer Carry (KB): One kettlebell at each side; log ONE kettlebell’s weight.
Farmer Carry (Handles): Farmer handles held at each side; log ONE loaded handle.
Neutral-Grip Incline Press (DB): Same incline press with palms facing one another.
Romanian Deadlift (Smith): Same bilateral hip hinge with a guided bar path.
Romanian Deadlift (KB): Two kettlebells held near the legs; log ONE kettlebell’s weight.
Chest-Supported Rear-Delt Fly (DB): Chest on an incline bench; raise the arms outward with a soft elbow.
Seated Rear-Delt Fly (DB): Seated and hinged forward; keep the torso still during the reverse fly.
Seated Curl (DB): Seated, upper arms at the sides, palms-up curl.
Straight-Bar Pressdown: Straight attachment and palms-down grip; upper arms stay at the sides.
Weighted Neutral-Grip Pull-Up: Palms facing; log added external weight using the existing weighted-pull-up convention.
Weighted Chin-Up: Palms toward you; elbow-flexor contribution differs from an overhand pull-up.
Seated Overhead Press (DB): Seated strict press with back support; no leg drive.
Seated Overhead Press (BB): Seated strict barbell press; no leg drive.
Smith Machine Shoulder Press: Seated vertical press using the guided Smith bar.
Captain’s Chair Knee Raise: Forearms supported; curl the pelvis upward with bent knees.
Captain’s Chair Leg Raise: Forearms supported; longer leg lever than the knee raise.
Lying Reverse Crunch: Floor support removes the hanging demand; curl the pelvis toward the ribs.
Neutral-Grip Dead Hang: Palms-facing handles change the grip while retaining a two-arm hang.
Thick-Bar Dead Hang: Thicker bar increases grip demand; duration has its own history.
